commit.message:
Stop the fabricated repo in vercelIgnore.test.ts from repacking itself

What broke. `npm test` failed 7 of 9 plain runs at 0faf606 with ENOTEMPTY
from afterEach's rmSync in tests/vercelIgnore.test.ts, and 0 of 9 at
ddd9a37. The test file and web/scripts/vercel-ignore.mjs are identical in
both trees.

How it was shown. Each case builds a Git repository from web/, src/,
scripts/ and tests/fixtures and commits it. `git commit` starts a detached
`git maintenance run --auto`. Under Git 2.54 that repacks when objects/17
holds two or more loose objects (crafted blobs: one does not trigger it, two
do). The fabricated repo holds one such object at ddd9a37 and at f7775c9,
and two at 0faf606, so only the PR's bytes started a repack, which was still
writing .git/objects while the short cases removed the directory. GIT_TRACE
on the first commit shows `git repack -d -l --cruft` at the head and nothing
at the merge-base.

The fix. The fabricated repo sets maintenance.auto=false and gc.auto=0
after init. With it, six plain runs of the full suite passed (950 of 950
each, on a tree that also held this review's three added cases).
What the cases assert is unchanged.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.2 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Restore the power of two tests the clearing rewrote

What broke. To keep the retired lens name out of the test sources, the
duplicate-key case in tests/urlCodecs.test.ts was changed from
`?lens=ledger&lens=broadcast` to `?lens=ledger&lens=ledger`. With two equal
values the test passes whether canonicalSearch keeps the first duplicate or
the last. In tests/dom/theme.test.tsx the Broadcast step became
`setDark(true); setDark(false); expect light` on Ledger, which ends where it
started and passes with a listener that no longer follows the OS.

How it was shown. With `params.get(key)` swapped for
`params.getAll(key).at(-1)`, tests/urlCodecs.test.ts passed 19 of 19 at
0faf606 and failed at ddd9a37. With the OS-change handler returning early
outside Poster, the PR's theme test passed 7 of 7.

The fix. The duplicate case uses two different surviving values in both
orders, and the theme test reads the root attribute after each OS change.
Both mutations now fail their test; unmutated, both files pass.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.2 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Pin the unset-kickoff and Brooklyn-day rules on the two remaining heroes

What broke. The Broadcast ticker's DOM cases were the only tests that
rendered a hero with a league-unset NEXT, and its selector cases the only
ones that checked a later-day NEXT against its Brooklyn date. Removing the
ticker removed them. The two heroes that stay, NextUpStrip and TonightSlate,
were rendered by one test, with exact times only.

How it was shown. With both heroes changed to print the filler instant as a
clock for a placeholder kickoff, `npm test` passed 947 of 947, web's
`npm test` 120 of 120, and typecheck was clean, at 0faf606.

The fix. Three cases in tests/dom/designCycle.test.tsx, on the real
`upcoming` and `planSlate` selectors and the app's clock, with snapshot rows
picked by position and overridden in memory: every Next-up card and its
overflow line read TBC with no clock; the Poster slate row reads TBC and its
sub-line names no time; a kickoff at 00:30 UTC is "Tomorrow" on Ledger and
"Sun 6 Sep" on Poster, not the UTC date. Five mutations (card, overflow
line, slate row, card date, slate title) each fail one of them.
docs/HONESTY.md rule 3 named the ticker; it now names what the heroes do.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.2 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Finish the two-lens wording the clearing missed

What was wrong at 0faf606, each read against the code or measured:
- README.md still said the football app is "read through three visual
  lenses", two lines above a gallery of two.
- TabNav's comment said the underline is "floodlight in each lens" (it is
  pitch in both) and that the switcher cannot fit on the tab row at "all
  three phone widths". Measured in Chrome on both production builds: the
  row needs 331 px with Oswald loaded, so it wraps at 360 and fits at 375
  (3.86 px spare) and 390 (18.86 px); with the fallback face it needs 394 px
  and wraps at all three.
- vite.config.ts still listed the marquee among what jsdom cannot check.
- pr-comment.md asked for six 390 px captures; browser-matrix.md says four.
- scripts/vercel-smoke.mjs still said every landmark is a receipt selector;
  the Fixtures one no longer is.
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, which the README links as the current map, listed
  the ticker, month cells, US broadcasters, a Broadcast-first theme, three
  lens heroes and a `view` URL key. docs/README.md described it the same way.

The implementation prompt fenced docs/ as history (decision 6) and also said
text describing the current app changes with it (decision 7). ARCHITECTURE.md
is a current description, so decision 7 governs it; the dated records under
docs/ are untouched. Comments and prose only: dist/ and web/.next/static are
byte-identical to the 0faf606 build.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.2 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Record PR #320's out-of-scope rows and review notes in the ideas file

Rows 118 to 123: the tab row's 4 px margin at 375 and its font-swap shift,
the heroes' empty copy, the removal audit as a standing test, the retained
next-fixture markers, "1 MATCHES", and the proof scripts N7 inherits. Rows
10 and the month half of 11 close by removal. The process notes carry what
this cold review learned about attributing a flake, testing a removal by
mutation, and measuring a row with the webfont late, plus the skill retro.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.2 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Renumber this review's ideas rows to 125 through 130

PR #316 (v0.5.4), open beside this one, already numbers rows 118 to 124 in
docs/v0.2.6-ideas.md on its branch. The six rows d737ceb added took 118 to
123 as well, so whichever PR merged second would have had to renumber and
every citation of the other's rows would have gone stale. They now start at
125. Text is unchanged apart from one clause in row 125 that says why, and a
pointer from the flake note to PR #316's row 120, which records the same
ENOTEMPTY without a cause.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.2 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Spell the retired names in the tests that cover them.

Escaping those names kept a literal grep empty, and one rewrite made to avoid the word could no longer fail. A node-project audit now allows each remaining occurrence by file and reason.

Name the Git 2.54 task that repacks the fabricated repo.

Two loose objects in objects/17 do trigger geometric-repack, and one does not. gc.auto is not that switch: 0 and 6700 both still repack. maintenance.auto=false is the line that stops it.

Point the server lens check at the radio that is actually checked.

The markup never renders a data-lens attribute, so asserting its absence could not fail. The checked Poster or Ledger radio is the decode the server renders.

Record the smoke landmark and correct the ideas rows this review closed.

The preview checker now looks for Jump to today, which is what later previews will be held to. Rows 10 and 11 still described removed work as open, and row 116 still gave Broadcast a dark default.

v0.5.4 — extra time and penalties are finals of their own (#316)

ESPN's STATUS_FINAL_AET and STATUS_FINAL_PEN are stored as after_extra_time and after_penalties, with ESPN's score and, for a penalty final, the shootout. One such result no longer refuses the snapshot for every league. A finished row reads AET or PENS and never FT, and the form guide still counts only a full-time result. A change from one final status to another is urgent at any horizon, and a correction of the shootout alone is an urgent result change. A final whose score or shootout is missing or malformed, or whose shootout is level, is refused, and that refuses the whole snapshot.

Built and rebutted by Cursor, reviewed cold by Claude; Pass 2.5 and the re-read ran on GPT-6.1 Sol. Not done: a 90-minute score (docs/v0.2.6-ideas.md row 118) and containing an unknown status to its own competition (row 119). The merge day moved from Mon 16 Nov to Sat 14 Nov 2026 on Beni's word.

A match may go long. The sync no longer stops for it.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
Co-authored-by: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit.message:
Merge origin/main into the clearing.

Bring v0.5.4's extra-time and penalty finals onto the branch that retires Broadcast, Where to Watch and the Monthly view, without rewriting the fourteen reviewed commits.

Release v0.5.5.

The clearing is the public release Beni numbered on 14 Nov 2026, before the cutover and the design overhaul.

Recapture the README's football pictures from the v0.5.5 build.

The October pictures still showed Broadcast, Where to Watch and the Monthly view.

Keep the removal audit off generated snapshot text.

A venue can contain the retired word, and the same word now matches without regard to case.

Close the ENOTEMPTY row and file the privacy-copy row.

Three plain test runs at this tip were green, and N5 still has to say what happens to the Broadcast theme key left in browsers.
